featured.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
featured.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie framed the "bitter lesson" question for the applied AI layer: as models improve, what's the best way to diffuse that intelligence into an enterprise? His counterintuitive take is that more capable models — longer-running tasks, better tool use — increase rather than decrease domain-by-domain differentiation. When models were limited, apps could only be "wrappers" delivering tokens via custom prompts or light RAG. In a world of tool-using agents, multi-day tasks, coordinated agent swarms, domain…
featured.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 抛出了应用层 AI 的「苦涩教训」之问：模型越来越强，企业该如何把这些智能扩散进组织？他的判断反直觉——模型越强、越能跑长任务和用工具，垂直领域的差异化空间反而越大。模型能力有限时，应用层只能做「套壳」（定制 prompt + 简单 RAG）；而进入 agent 调用工具、任务持续数小时甚至数天、多 agent 协同、领域专属数据源与模型路由、真实的流程变革管理的阶段，系统专业化程度只会更高。他也承认离大模型厂商核心场景越近越难做，但预计安全、生命科学、医疗、金融、制造等领域会出现大量此前不可行的自主系统。

featured.title: Thariq · Anthropic Claude Code
featured.summaryEn: Thariq from Anthropic's Claude Code team argues that most people multi-tasking with agents could benefit from slowing down: most of what you're doing won't really matter — what's your P0, and what would it look like if you gave it your full attention? The post drew 5,000+ likes, hitting a nerve about attention fragmentation in the agent era.
featured.insightZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队的 Thariq 给「多 agent 并行干活」的人泼了盆冷水：大多数同时调度一堆 agent 的人其实应该慢下来——你手上的大部分事情并不重要，真正的 P0 是什么？如果你把全部注意力放在它上面，会是什么样子？这条获得 5000+ 点赞，戳中了 agent 时代的注意力碎片化痛点。

featured.title: Why Every Traded Personal Agents for One Company Agent
featured.summaryEn: Every went from "everyone gets a personal OpenClaw agent" to "one shared company agent" — at work, one agent per company beats many personal ones, while highly personalized agents win at home. Every CEO Dan Shipper and head of platform Willie Williams retraced the journey. Early this year everyone at Every ran OpenClaws, Slack filled with bots, and the biggest win was learning by watching how others used AI. But problems surfaced fast: setup was too technical for non-engineers, security was a worry, things broke, and agents faded without constant investment. Their one-click claw platform "Plus One" struggled because OpenClaw moved fast and was vibe coded, making it a hard platform foundation; most claws quietly died — Dan's R2C2 never came back after a Mac mini lost power, since he'd moved to Codex. Remembering which agent had which expertise was annoying, and well-built agents like Aus…
featured.insightZh: Every 从「人手一个 OpenClaw 个人 agent」走到「全公司共用一个 company agent」——工作场景里一家公司一个 agent 更优，个人场景则留给高度个性化的个人 agent。 Every CEO Dan Shipper 与平台负责人 Willie Williams 复盘了这段历程。今年初 Every 全员跑 OpenClaw，Slack 里满是 bot，最大的收获是「看到别人怎么用 AI」带来的学习效应。但问题也很快暴露：对非技术同事来说配置太复杂、安全顾虑多、经常坏、不持续投入就会荒废。他们曾试图做一键造 claw 的平台「Plus One」，但 OpenClaw 迭代太快、本身是 vibe coded，很难作为平台底座，大家的 claw 也陆续「死掉」。Dan 的 R2C2 在 Mac mini 断电后再没重启，因为他已经转向 Codex。 转折点在于：记住哪个 agent 擅长什么很烦；像 Austin 的增长 agent 那样做得好的 agent 自然成为引力中心。Willie 认为「builder 想暴露复杂度，operator 只想要能用的东西」，于是 Every 把精力集中到一个全公司共同贡献、学习公司流程的 agent 上，并作为 Every Agent 对订阅用户发布。双方的共识是：工作侧一家公司（或组织）一个 agent，必要时再按团队分化；个人侧 OpenAI dots、Muse、Instinct 等个人 agent 会因个性化而非常有吸引力。Dan 还预测：一年后他仍会用持久化 agent，但可爱的角色名（他的 dot 叫 Boo）大概不会留下。 关于工程管理，Willie 认为在 AI 时代经理仍是「人的工作」，价值在于消除瓶颈；他转回管理后 token 用量断崖下降。AI 主要提升信息面：用 Tend 把 Slack、邮件、客户反馈、会议汇成一个 feed；用 agent 每 5 分钟巡检异常并智能路由，充当永远在岗的第一值班人。双方也看好「主动式 AI」：每个人和每家公司都能拥有自己的 feed，帮你从 X、S…

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch announced they open-sourced a "really fast" HTML artifact builder powered by libfx, which makes the agent durable. He said building the low-level plumbing for v0 to survive server crashes, flaky LLMs and function limits was a huge pain — now it's easy, free and OSS. He added it runs at 1,000 tokens per second, plus a separate "More free AI" post.
items.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 宣布开源一个「非常快」的 HTML artifact 构建器，底层由 libfx 驱动，让 agent 具备持久性（durable）。他坦言为 v0 搭建能扛住服务器崩溃、LLM 不稳定、函数限制的底层管道曾经非常痛苦，现在这套能力免费开源。他还补充该方案速度可达每秒 1,000 tokens，并另发一条「More free AI」。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: FPV Ventures partner Nikunj Kothari wrote a long endorsement of Wabi 2.0 (explicitly unpaid, not an investor). He splits today's personal agents into two types: single-player iMessage/Muse-style agents that are hard to compartmentalize, and DIY multi-chat Hermes agents that share context but live forever. Wabi's paradigm is an orchestrator agent plus proactively generated, topic-specific episodic chats that can be shared (e.g. a school chat with his wife) and archived when done — like a NY trip helper spawned from…
items.insightZh: FPV Ventures 合伙人 Nikunj Kothari 发长文力荐 Wabi 2.0（声明非付费、非投资人）。他把当下个人 agent 分两类：一是单人 iMessage / Muse 式，事情一多难以分区；二是自建多个 Hermes 式聊天 agent，能共享上下文但会永久存在。Wabi 的范式是「主编排 agent + 按主题生成的一次性对话」：可主动生成、可分享给他人（如和妻子共享学校相关对话），任务结束即归档——比如根据航班自动生成纽约行程助手，旅行结束后归档；报税同理。他唯一的批评是「过于主动」，应用质量也需打磨。另一条他调侃 VC 圈的热词堆砌：「数据中心里的多肽工厂 + 机器人 neolab + 一方独占数据」。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
items.summaryEn: Y Combinator President & CEO Garry Tan also highlighted Wabi: multiplayer agents in the form of a group chat seem inevitable, and Wabi has built it.
items.insightZh: Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO Garry Tan 同样点名 Wabi：多人协作 agent 以「群聊」形态出现几乎是必然趋势，而 Wabi 已经把它做出来了。

items.title: Peter Yang · AI 教程与访谈创作者
items.summaryEn: AI tutorials and interviews creator Peter Yang also shared Wabi content, praising how visual it is and saying he can't wait to try it. Separately, he shared an interesting insight into why many Netflix originals are "slop," while noting he still loves a few (especially Korean ones).
items.insightZh: AI 教程与访谈创作者 Peter Yang 也转发了 Wabi 相关内容，称赞其非常可视化，期待试用。另一条他分享了一个关于「为什么很多 Netflix 原创影视是 slop（粗制内容）」的有趣洞察，但表示仍喜欢其中一些（尤其韩剧）。

items.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT
items.summaryEn: OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT lead Thibault Sottiaux continued his "Day 15" series: first "We're cooked," then "Nevermind, we're still cooking... and reset. Enjoy." The two posts drew 6,000+ likes combined; details are in the attached media.
items.insightZh: OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT 负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 延续「Day 15」系列：先发「We're cooked」，随后改口「Nevermind，我们还在继续做……并且 reset 了，enjoy」。两条合计 6000+ 点赞，具体内容以原帖附图为准。

items.title: Swyx · Latent Space / AI Engineer
items.summaryEn: Swyx (Latent Space / AI Engineer) used a Bhagavad Gita-style dialogue to satirize X discourse: everyone claims to want the end of chat and to leave X, yet keeps returning and re-announcing it. His punchline: the chief desire of the people of X is not the truth, but the new.
items.insightZh: Latent Space / AI Engineer 的 Swyx 用一段仿《薄伽梵歌》的对话讽刺 X 上的舆论：人人都说想「终结聊天界面」、想离开 X，却一次次回来、反复宣布。他的结论是——X 用户真正渴望的不是真相，而是「新」。
